label: run143 redo — re-baseline on local-30 outages
definition: PROBE / fresh baseline. The run143 KEEPER recipe re-solved BYTE-FAITHFULLY, changing ONLY the outage inputs: the ERCOT CAMPD outage filter switched from the over-tight single-annual net-load band to the centered +/-30d LOCAL net-load band (CC outage GW-days 2906->5997). The committed run143 numbers were solved on the stale annual-band outages, so this re-baseline is the correct comparison point for any reserve-curve lever. Scores (demand-wtd avg / hourly-MAE / h>200 / h>500, vs actual RTSPP): 2023 35.2/27.9/89/51 (stale run143 36.5/-/104/56; actual 48.4/181/104); 2024 25.4/15.0/33/23 (stale 23.2/22/16; actual 26.8/53/16); 2025 32.5/11.6/1/0 (stale 31.4/1/0; actual 32.5/31/3). The local-30 outages nudge 2024's deep tail to a mild OVER-fire (h>500 23 vs actual 16) and leave the P90-P99 'moderately scarce' band still HOLLOW (2024 model P95 29.6 vs actual 61.4; 2025 P95 49.7 vs 76.7) — the documented monthly-shape residual the reserve-demand-curve / reserve-supply levers target. Operating-shape gate: 10 regressions vs the (old-outage) keeper baseline, dominated by ST_GAS (cf_emd/r) and CC_REGULAR — these are the outage-change shape shifts, the pre-existing baseline for the published-ORDC re-gate. NOT a keeper (no attestation; pending volume re-gate).
